candidates.name: git-stash documentation
verified_facts: git stash push records the current working tree and index state
--include-untracked includes untracked files and cleans them from the working tree
semantic_limits: The recovery keeps refs/stash for manual inspection and never automatically reapplies or drops it

candidates.name: git-status porcelain format
verified_facts: Porcelain v1 is designed as a stable machine-readable status format
semantic_limits: Status detects repository changes but does not decide whether they are valuable; the snapshot and stash preserve them

candidates.name: git-fetch atomic synchronization
verified_facts: git fetch downloads remote objects and updates remote-tracking refs
semantic_limits: Fetch does not modify the worktree; an exact verified reset is still required

candidates.name: Wait-Process Timeout
verified_facts: Wait-Process waits for a process to stop
The Timeout parameter bounds the wait and reports when the interval expires
semantic_limits: A timeout receipt is a fail-closed blocker and is not treated as successful recovery
